svg.aria-label: Voice-Pipes — Modular Real-Time Conversational Voice Runtime in Rust

text.tspan: Orchestrate streaming speech over WebSockets with sub-500ms turn latency,
instant barge-in cancellation, 20+ hot-swappable local & cloud plugins,
and per-turn Gantt timeline observability built into the Admin Console.

g.text: 48.2 tok/s · 38 tok · 0.14x RTF · TTS 510ms · 🎤 "Switch flight to 6 PM" → 💬 "Moved to 6:00 PM."
